chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Rifa'ah ibn Musa, who said:

I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about the woman who makes a vow upon herself to fast two consecutive months. He (peace be upon him) said: 'She fasts, and resumes her days which she stayed (from fasting), until she completes two months.' I said, 'What is your view if she has despaired of menstruation (i.e., reached menopause), does she make it up?' He (peace be upon him) said: 'She does not make it up; the first (period) suffices for her.'
ai.seo_question: Does a woman need to make up missed fasting days for a vow if she reaches menopause before completing it?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that for a vow of two consecutive months, menstruation breaks the continuity but does not invalidate the vow; the woman must resume fasting after her period ends to complete the count. Notably, if she reaches menopause (ya's min al-mahid) before finishing, the missed days are not made up, as the initial fulfilled portion is deemed sufficient, reflecting a pragmatic approach to vows in Shia jurisprudence. This ruling highlights the distinction between obligatory fasts, which require makeup, and voluntary vows, where continuity is key but not absolute in cases of permanent interruption.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Ali, from Rafa’at Bin Musa who said,

‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about the woman who made a vow. Upon her was the Fasting of two months consecutively. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘She would Fast, and she would resume her days which she stayed (not Fasting), until she completes two months’. I said, ‘What is your<sup>asws</sup> view if she has despaired from the menstruation (in menopause), does she make up for it?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘She would not make up for it. Her first (time around) would suffice for her’.
en.sarwar: 10. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Hassan ibn Ali from Rifa’ah ibn Musa who has said the following: “I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the case of a woman who vows to fast for two consecutive months.
